action.command: cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {split($2,a,":"); port=strtonum("0x" a[2]); if ($4=="0A") print port}' | sort -un | head -20

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cat /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {split($2,a,\":\"); port=strtonum(\"0x\" a[2]); if ($4==\"0A\") print port}' | sort -un | head -20", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "List listening ports from /proc"}
